facts.fact: The ministries of civil registration and social protection signed an agreement integrating the National Population Registration System with the social protection system to verify existence and live status of persons.
Namibia's Chief Registrar said all applicants for the Covid-19 Emergency Income Grant were verified against the NPRS, and social protection verifies live status against it.
The Ministry says its mandate is to manage the National Population Register and that the National Population Registration System (NPRS, e-NPRS) holds ID application records and verifies them.
The Ministry says the e-birth notification system electronically notifies the e-NPRS of a birth and captures the child's birth details, and deaths are notified electronically in line with births.
The Ministry says the e-birth notification system verifies the mother's identity against the NPRS.

facts.fact: UCSF's NAMTAC page says the master patient index is linked with the National Population Registry System (NPRS), using Namibian ID numbers and birth certificate numbers.
UCSF's NAMTAC page says the health master patient index draws on the NPRS for ID numbers of people over 16 and birth certificate numbers for those under 16.
The Auditor General compared 488,753 social grant beneficiaries on the Integrated Social Assistance System with the National Population Registration System and found 8,099 unmatched.
The Auditor General's report says social grant recipients on the Integrated Social Assistance System were checked against records in the National Population Registration System.
The deputy minister said historic marriage and death records are "not on the National Population Register System", which implies the register is in service.
